comparison.objective: Erase four marks from a wipe-clean board and return the sponge to START.
comparison.physical_skill: Surface contact, wiping coverage, and sponge placement.
comparison.success_condition: All four marks are erased and the sponge returns to START; setup and scoring thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests compliant surface wiping rather than impact-mediated component finishing and debris recovery.
